areaNotes: Re-audited exclusively from commit 92480fab via Git objects; no working-tree files, builds, tests or network were used. The T-247/T-251/T-254 threading implementation is present and the earlier pre-rebuild threading verdict is obsolete. Self-skeptic pass found no hidden capability blocker and verified 1be's most likely missing element—the quoted parent—at CommentsView.swift:1216. When visual behavior could not be proven without running the app, the conclusion is explicitly source-only.
reauditSummary:
FIXED

- `1f.5`: T-247 replaced the old cards/depth-two projection with flat elbow-rail rows through depth 5; T-251/T-254 fixed cutoff counts and collapse behavior.
- `1ba.2`: the 10,000-character budget now counts Unicode scalars/code points.

STILL OPEN

- `1f.4`: continuous loading is still pagination; the current audit method calls this an open owner decision.

WRONG

- The old `1f.5` description of the live implementation is stale at `92480fab`, although the old audit correctly warned that it predated T-247.
- `1ba.1` overclaimed completion: the drag-taller footer is absent and replies say “Post Reply”.
- The old `1bf` BUILT verdict checked sanitizer compatibility but missed the row-for-tile substitution and the `h1–h6` → `h3` reduction.
provenance: Codex (gpt-5.6-sol), 2026-09-25, read-only at 92480fab; supersedes the 1f/1ba/1be/1bf entries of browse-workdetail-comments.json, which predate T-247.
